title: Where the Base Goes
caption:
Beauty Note — No. 04
Where the Base Goes

A base prepares the skin for foundation.
So where your foundation goes decides where your base goes.

A base also corrects. Choose it for what your skin needs, and apply it there.
A pore-blurring base, mainly where pores show.
A moist, hydrating base, mainly where skin feels dry.

Know what your base does, and where it belongs. That alone changes the finish.

Never all over the face.
Foundation and base are complete at the centre of the face.
Only what is needed, only where it is needed.
